sloka: परिगृह्य च बाहुभ्यां परिवृत्य शिरोधराम्।उत्पाटयामास शिरो भैरवं नदतो महत् ।। ६.७७.२३ ।।
transliteration: parigṛhya ca bāhubhyāṁ parivṛtya śirodharām।utpāṭayāmāsa śiro bhairavaṁ nadato mahat ।। 6.77.23 ।।

translations.english: And thereafter as Nikumbha killed by windgod's son was crying aloud in the battlefield, a violent and fierce war took place between the highly disturbed son of Dasharatha and Rakshasa Makara.
